capabilities: display a selected Markdown note in a pop-up panel beside the Ribbon
open the panel by hover, click, command, hotkey, or obsidian:// URI
edit the navigation note in place with automatic saving
activate wikilinks and preview them on hover without leaving the panel
customize icon, size, opening mode, and panel CSS variables
disambiguation: Not a vault navigator or sidebar file tree; it shows one user-chosen Markdown note in a pop-up panel.
extras: Desktop-only and requires Obsidian 1.5.0 or later. The README documents known limitations: split panes may open tabs in the wrong pane, and link clicks can conflict with Obsidian 1.14.4 event delegation. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Keeping a navigation or quick-reference note visible costs a workspace tab, and Obsidian has no built-in pop-out panel for a persistent reference document.

relations.evidence: Callouts, tables, task lists, ![[embeds]], and rendered Dataview results are also supported.
Add these URIs as links in your notes, or call them through Meta Bind

summary: Markdown navigation panel that displays a chosen note in a pop-up beside the Ribbon, with hover or click access, in-place editing, and link handling.
